report.answer: Thursday 2024-08-01 recorded 39,790 trips in the 0–17 window versus Wednesday 2024-07-31's 63,927, a 37.8% raw gap. The critical difference in coverage (15 vs 18 hours) means the raw totals are not directly comparable; however, even after confining to the like-for-like 0–17 window, Thursday's demand remains substantially lower, indicating an intrinsic day-of-week collapse rather than a coverage artifact. Weather on Thursday featured extreme heat (wmo_code 51) with only 0.1 mm rain, while Wednesday had 9.9 mm rain and overcast conditions; despite the rainier day, Wednesday's trips were 61% higher, suggesting the heat on Thursday suppressed demand. Airport trips were nearly identical in proportion (11.1% vs 11.0%) but absolutely lower on Thursday (4,416 vs 7,045), contributing to the total shortfall but not driving it disproportionately.
